(20 October) |longest wins= |longest unbeaten= |longest losses= |prevseason= [[2023 Primera Nacional|2023]] |nextseason= [[2025 Primera Nacional|2025]] }} The '''2024 Argentine Primera Nacional''',{{cite web |url=https://www.afa.com.ar/Sitio/posts/se-llevo-a-cabo-el-sorteo-del-campeonato-de-primera-nacional-2024 |title=Se llevó a cabo el sorteo del Campeonato de Primera Nacional 2024 |trans-title=The draw for the 2024 Campeonato de Primera Nacional was held |publisher=[[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] |language=es |date=3 January 2024 |access-date=30 January 2024}} was the 40th season of the [[Primera Nacional]], the second-tier competition of [[Football in Argentina|Argentine]] football. The season began on 2 February and ended on 8 December 2024. Thirty-eight teams competed in the league, thirty-three of which took part in the [[2023 Primera Nacional|2023 season]], along with two teams relegated from [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]], one team promoted from [[Torneo Federal A]] and two teams promoted from [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. [[Club Atlético Aldosivi|Aldosivi]] won their second Primera Nacional title and promoted to Primera División in this season, defeating [[San Martín de Tucumán|San Martín (T)]] 2–0 in the championship final played on 3 November 2024.{{cite web |url=https://www.tycsports.com/primera-nacional/san-martin-t-vs-aldosivi-en-vivo-hora-donde-ver-y-formaciones-id616759.html |title=Aldosivi venció a San Martín de Tucumán y se quedó con el primer ascenso a la Liga Profesional |trans-title=Aldosivi beat San Martín de Tucumán and claimed the first promotion to the Liga Profesional |publisher=[[TyC Sports]] |language=es |date=3 November 2024 |access-date=3 November 2024}} [[San Martín de San Juan|San Martín (SJ)]] were the other promoted side, winning the Torneo Reducido after defeating [[Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza|Gimnasia y Esgrima (M)]] in the final.{{cite web |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/ascenso/viene-final-segundo-ascenso-primera-gimnasia-m-vs-san-martin-san-juan_0_XkfNkeGYUr.html |title=San Martín de San Juan es de Primera: venció 2-0 a Gimnasia (M) |trans-title=San Martín de San Juan belong to ''Primera'': they beat Gimnasia (M) 2–0 |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=8 December 2024 |access-date=8 December 2024}} ==Format== For this season, the competition was played under a format similar to the one used in the last season, with the thirty-eight participating teams being split into two zones of 19 teams each, where they played against the other teams in their group twice: once at home and once away, additionally, each team played two interzonal matches against its rival team, which was drawn into the other zone. Teams from the same city or nearby cities were also paired together and drawn into different zones. Both zone winners played a final match on neutral ground to decide the first promoted team to the [[Argentine Primera División|Liga Profesional]] for the 2025 season, while the teams placed from second to eighth place in each zone played a knockout tournament (''Torneo Reducido'') for the second promotion berth along with the loser of the final between the zone winners, which entered the Reducido in the second round.{{cite web |title=Primera Nacional 2024: así se jugará el campeonato |trans-title=2024 Primera Nacional: this is how the championship will be played |url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-ascenso/ascenso-primera-nacional_0_ciq4mLmonI.html |publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]] |language=es |date=26 December 2023 |access-date=30 January 2024}} The teams placing last in each zone were relegated at the end of the season, with a third relegated team decided in a playoff match between the sides placing second-from-bottom in each group. Similar to previous seasons, 15 Primera Nacional teams qualified for the [[2025 Copa Argentina]] through league performance, those being the top seven teams of each zone plus the best eighth-placed one.{{cite web|url=https://www.afa.com.ar/upload/NuevaCarpeta%202/Bolet%C3%ADn%20Especial%206446%20-%20Reglamento%20Clasificaci%C3%B3n%20Copa%20Argentina%202025.pdf |title=Boletín Especial 6446 - Reglamento Clasificación Copa Argentina 2025 |trans-title=Special Bulletin 6446 - 2025 Copa Argentina Qualification Regulations |publisher=[[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] |language=es |date=7 March 2024 |access-date=19 March 2024}} ==Club information== === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Argentina |float=right |width=350 |caption=Locations of the 2024 Primera Nacional teams outside [[Greater Buenos Aires]]. |places= {{location map~ |Argentina |lat=-34.603611 |long=-58.381667 |label=
